=== file-001.md ===
The Road to Our Door

Smoke gathers low beneath the paling sky,
Bare branches trace their shadows on the lane.
My boots disturb the copper leaves that lie
Like little letters scattered in the rain.
One window warms the blue at end of day;
Its amber square outshines the distant star.
The kettle's breath will greet the wool and clay
I carry home from fields and roads afar.
The gate gives way, familiar in its sigh,
And lamplight spills across the threshold stone.
I leave the wind and darkening world outside;
Within, the waiting rooms remember home.

=== file-001.md ===
The Road Back

The last bus sighs beside the thinning trees,
Gold leaves gather at the curb like letters.
I turn where the familiar porch light glows,
Past chimneys breathing blue into the dusk.
My key is cold, then warm within my hand;
The door remembers how to let me in.
Soup carries its small weather through the hall,
And floorboards answer softly underfoot.
The clock resumes its patient, amber tide,
While rain begins a hush against the glass.
I set the distant day down by the door
And find my name waiting in the quiet.

=== file-001.md ===
The Lantern Road
Maples burn low beneath the thinning light,
I cross the gate where evening gathers blue.
Cool woodsmoke curls from chimneys into night,
And every window holds a welcome through.
My boots bring leaves along the garden path;
They whisper gold against the porch’s stone.
The old door opens with its gentle breath,
And sheds the distances I have known.
Inside, the kettle hums its amber song,
Warm lamplight pools across the familiar floor.
The season’s wandering settles where I belong,
And home receives me, quiet as before.

=== file-001.md ===
Lanterns at the Door

The train leaves its silver breath behind,
and maples stitch the dusk with fire.
My footsteps know the narrow lane
before my eyes can name the shire.
Smoke lifts softly from the chimneys,
warm spice gathers in the air.
The porch light blooms across the rain,
a small gold answer waiting there.
I turn the key; the old floor sings.
Coats, cups, and quiet hold me near.
Outside, the leaves keep falling down;
inside, I have arrived again.

=== file-001.md ===
Homeward

At dusk, I turn beneath the bronze-lit trees,
Cold air carries woodsmoke down the lane.
The last leaves gather softly at my knees,
And window lamps appear through misty rain.
My footsteps know the hush between the fields,
The gate's familiar creak, the garden wall.
The fading sky lays ember-colored shields
Across the roofs that wait beyond it all.
A kettle sings behind the curtained glass,
Warm gold spills gently over worn stone floors.
I leave the darkening road and let it pass,
Then breathe, at last, beside my open door.

=== file-001.md ===
Autumn Return

The bus sighs softly at the corner curb,
Leaves follow me along the fading street.
A chimney sends its ribbon through the dusk,
And porch lights make the quiet pavement sweet.

My key is cold between my waiting hands,
The gate gives way with one familiar sound.
Inside, the hall holds warmth and lamplight still,
While rain begins to darken all the ground.

I hang my coat beside the kitchen door,
And hear the kettle gathering its song.
The evening settles gently in the rooms,
And home receives me like I belong.
